name: replay-edge-server
description: Edge server (Raspberry Pi) - ingests camera stream, keeps a rolling window of chunks, cuts and uploads replays

scripts.sim:camera: ffmpeg -re -f lavfi -i "testsrc=size=1280x720:rate=30" -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=1000" -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 30 -keyint_min 30 -sc_threshold 0 -c:a aac -f flv rtmp://127.0.0.1:1935/live/stream
